decisive_items: Extensive white matter changes with enhancement along the arachnoid surface in the interhemispheric fissure extending over the frontal lobes bilaterally
lymphocytes and plasma cells with occasional Russell bodies and eosinophils
response.rationale: The combination of white matter changes, arachnoid surface enhancement, and lymphocytic inflammation with Russell bodies is more suggestive of neurosarcoidosis than other options, despite some overlapping features with rheumatoid meningitis.

rejected.why: Lack of specific pathological features and absence of acute infarcts make multiple sclerosis less likely.
No evidence of vasculitis on biopsy and normal MRA make CNS vasculitis less likely.
